text.en:
MALACAÑANG
PRESIDENTIAL DECREE No. 589 November 28, 1974
MAKING RULES AND REGULATIONS ISSUED BY THE CIVIL AERONAUTICS ADMINISTRATION
PURSUANT TO R.A. 776 BINDING UPON THE PASSENGER AND SHIPPER
WHEREAS, the Civil Aeronautics Board, under the provisions of Republic Act No. 776, as amended, is given
the power to regulate the economic aspect of air transportation to issue, make and amend such general and
special rules and regulations to carry out the provisions of the said Act and to passed upon the reasonableness
of, approve or disapprove, the conditions of carriage or tariff which an airline desires to adopt;
WHEREAS, experience has shown that there is need to make the rules and regulations issued by the Civil
Aeronautics Board under Republic Act No. 776 which affect not only the airlines but their passengers as well
as the conditions of carriage or passenger and/or cargo tariff approved by the Civil Aeronautics Board,
binding upon the passenger and/or shippers, in order to foster sound economic conditions in air transportation,
to improve the relations between air carriers and their passengers and/or shippers and enhance the efficiency
of airline operations;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers
vested in me by the Constitution, do hereby decree and order that all valid rules and regulations issued by the
Civil Aeronautics Board pursuant to the provisions of Republic Act No. 776 and the conditions of carriage
and tariff, safety, order and discipline duly approved by the Civil Aeronautics Board, shall be binding upon
the passenger and/or shipper, provided, that, such rules and regulations, conditions of carriage or tariff, safety,
order and discipline shall have first published in a newspaper of general circulation once a week for two (2)
consecutive weeks.
This Decree shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 28th day of November, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-four.
